# Accounting API endpoints

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:api` from src/services/catalogue.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

146 endpoints in 26 modules. Every path is relative to `/api/v1` on the accounting API and every call carries the
Trovesuite headers (`authorization`, `app-id`, `org-id`, `bus-id`, `loc-id`). Responses use the standard envelope; `data` is the shape
listed under **Returns**. See [API_CONVENTIONS.md](./API_CONVENTIONS.md) for headers, envelope, errors and pagination,
[PROCESSING_RULES.md](./PROCESSING_RULES.md) for what each write must enforce, and [DATA_MODEL.md](./DATA_MODEL.md) for the types named here.

Ids always go in the query string as `{resource}_id`, never in the path. Updates are `PUT` with a body containing only the fields to change
unless the body says otherwise. Sign-up and login are served by the Core Platform, not this API: see [AUTH_AND_ONBOARDING.md](./AUTH_AND_ONBOARDING.md).

## Platform

<a id="get-navigation"></a>

#### GET `/navigation`

Route map (same paths as Swagger).

- **Permission:** `authenticated`
- **Returns (`data`):** `{ items: { method, path, module, summary }[] }`

<a id="get-users-list"></a>

#### GET `/users/list`

Tenant users who can act in Accounting (resolved from cp_users).

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-user-list`
- **Returns (`data`):** `{ items: CurrentUser[] }`

| Query parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `page` | 1-based page (default 1) |
| `size` | Page size (default 20, max 100) |
| `sort_by` | Field to sort by; cf_<key> sorts by a custom field |
| `sort_order` | asc \| desc |
| `search` | Free-text search |

<a id="get-users-me"></a>

#### GET `/users/me`

The signed-in user (JWT user_id resolved against cp_users).

- **Permission:** `authenticated`
- **Returns (`data`):** `CurrentUser`

## Organisation

<a id="get-organisation-get"></a>

#### GET `/organisation/get`

Organisation profile and accounting policies.

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-organisation-get`
- **Returns (`data`):** `OrgSettings`

<a id="post-organisation-setup"></a>

#### POST `/organisation/setup`

First-run setup after sign-up: names, country, base currency, financial year. Allowed once..

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-organisation-update`
- **Returns (`data`):** `OrgSettings (setup_completed: true)`
- **Body:** `OrganisationSetupInput`
- **Client reloads after success:** `org`, `currencies`, `periods`

<a id="put-organisation-update"></a>

#### PUT `/organisation/update`

Update profile, numbering, approval threshold, FX accounts; base currency only while nothing is posted.

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-organisation-update`
- **Returns (`data`):** `OrgSettings`
- **Body:** `Partial<OrgSettings> (setup_completed is ignored)`
- **Client reloads after success:** `org`, `currencies`, `bankAccounts`, `customers`, `suppliers`

## Dimensions

<a id="get-dimensions-list"></a>

#### GET `/dimensions/list`

List dimensions (paginated).

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-dimension-list`
- **Returns (`data`):** `{ items: Dimension[] }`
- **Client cache:** loads `dimensions` (all pages, `size=500`)

| Query parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `page` | 1-based page (default 1) |
| `size` | Page size (default 20, max 100) |
| `sort_by` | Field to sort by; cf_<key> sorts by a custom field |
| `sort_order` | asc \| desc |
| `search` | Free-text search |
| `kind` | LEGAL_ENTITY \| BRANCH \| DEPARTMENT \| COST_CENTRE \| PROJECT |
| `is_active` | true \| false |

<a id="post-dimensions-add"></a>

#### POST `/dimensions/add`

Add a branch, department, cost centre or project.

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-dimension-add`
- **Returns (`data`):** `Dimension`
- **Body:** `{ kind, code, name, description? }`
- **Client reloads after success:** `dimensions`

<a id="put-dimensions-update"></a>

#### PUT `/dimensions/update`

Activate or deactivate a dimension.

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-dimension-update`
- **Returns (`data`):** `Dimension`
- **Body:** `{ is_active }`
- **Client reloads after success:** `dimensions`

| Query parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `dimension_id` | Dimension id |

## Currencies

<a id="get-currencies-list"></a>

#### GET `/currencies/list`

List currencies (paginated).

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-currency-list`
- **Returns (`data`):** `{ items: Currency[] }`
- **Client cache:** loads `currencies` (all pages, `size=500`)

| Query parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `page` | 1-based page (default 1) |
| `size` | Page size (default 20, max 100) |
| `sort_by` | Field to sort by; cf_<key> sorts by a custom field |

#### GET `/currencies/exposure`

Open foreign-currency receivables and payables in each currency, with the number of open documents.

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-currency-list`
- **Returns (`data`):** `CurrencyExposure`

<a id="post-currencies-add"></a>

#### POST `/currencies/add`

Add a currency (ISO 4217 code).

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-currency-add`
- **Returns (`data`):** `Currency`
- **Body:** `{ code, name, symbol }`
- **Client reloads after success:** `currencies`

<a id="put-currencies-update"></a>

#### PUT `/currencies/update`

Switch a currency on or off.

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-currency-update`
- **Returns (`data`):** `Currency`
- **Body:** `{ is_active }`
- **Client reloads after success:** `currencies`

| Query parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `currency_code` | ISO code, e.g. USD |

<a id="get-exchange-rates-list"></a>

#### GET `/exchange-rates/list`

List exchange rates (paginated).

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-exchange-rate-list`
- **Returns (`data`):** `{ items: ExchangeRate[] }`
- **Client cache:** loads `exchangeRates` (all pages, `size=500`)

| Query parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `page` | 1-based page (default 1) |
| `size` | Page size (default 20, max 100) |
| `sort_by` | Field to sort by; cf_<key> sorts by a custom field |
| `sort_order` | asc \| desc |
| `search` | Free-text search |
| `currency` | ISO code |
| `source` | MANUAL \| BANK_OF_GHANA |
| `from_date` | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `to_date` | YYYY-MM-DD |

<a id="post-exchange-rates-add"></a>

#### POST `/exchange-rates/add`

Record a manual rate (base per one unit of the currency).

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-exchange-rate-add`
- **Returns (`data`):** `ExchangeRate`
- **Body:** `{ currency, date, rate }`
- **Client reloads after success:** `exchangeRates`

<a id="delete-exchange-rates-delete"></a>

#### DELETE `/exchange-rates/delete`

Delete a manual rate (Bank of Ghana reference rates cannot be deleted).

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-exchange-rate-delete`

- **Client reloads after success:** `exchangeRates`

| Query parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `exchange_rate_id` | Rate id |

<a id="post-exchange-rates-fetch-reference"></a>

#### POST `/exchange-rates/fetch-reference`

Pull today's Bank of Ghana reference rates for every active foreign currency.

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-exchange-rate-add`

<a id="post-bills-void"></a>

#### POST `/bills/void`

- **Returns (`data`):** `null`

| Query parameter | Meaning |

| --- | --- |

<a id="get-reports-income-statement"></a>

#### GET `/reports/income-statement`

Profit and loss for a date range.

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-report-get`
- **Returns (`data`):** `IncomeStatement`

| Query parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `from_date` | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `to_date` | YYYY-MM-DD |

<a id="get-reports-balance-sheet"></a>

#### GET `/reports/balance-sheet`

Balance sheet as at a date.

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-report-get`
- **Returns (`data`):** `BalanceSheet`

| Query parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `as_at` | YYYY-MM-DD |

<a id="get-reports-cash-flow"></a>

#### GET `/reports/cash-flow`

Cash flow (direct method) for a date range.

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-report-get`
- **Returns (`data`):** `CashFlow`

| Query parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `from_date` | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `to_date` | YYYY-MM-DD |

<a id="get-reports-ar-ageing"></a>

#### GET `/reports/ar-ageing`

Receivables by customer and age bucket, with the open invoices behind each.

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-report-get`
- **Returns (`data`):** `AgeingReport`

| Query parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `as_at` | YYYY-MM-DD |

<a id="get-reports-ap-ageing"></a>

#### GET `/reports/ap-ageing`

Payables by supplier and age bucket, with the open bills behind each.

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-report-get`
- **Returns (`data`):** `AgeingReport`

| Query parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `as_at` | YYYY-MM-DD |

<a id="get-reports-monthly-trend"></a>

#### GET `/reports/monthly-trend`

Revenue, expenses, net profit and closing cash for each month in a range.

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-report-get`
- **Returns (`data`):** `MonthlyTrendReport`

| Query parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `from_date` | YYYY-MM-DD (default: first day of the month eleven months before to_date) |
| `to_date` | YYYY-MM-DD (default: today). The range covers at most 24 calendar months |

<a id="get-reports-tax-summary"></a>

#### GET `/reports/tax-summary`

VAT output, input and net payable plus withholding tax by month, with each month's return status and the tax account balances.

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-report-get`
- **Returns (`data`):** `TaxSummaryReport`

| Query parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `from_date` | YYYY-MM-DD (default: start of the financial year containing to_date) |
| `to_date` | YYYY-MM-DD (default: today). The range covers at most 24 calendar months |

<a id="get-reports-customer-statement"></a>

#### GET `/reports/customer-statement`

Statement of account for one customer in one currency.

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-report-get`
- **Returns (`data`):** `PartyStatement`

| Query parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `customer_id` | Customer id (required) |
| `from_date` | YYYY-MM-DD (default: start of the year) |
| `to_date` | YYYY-MM-DD (default: today) |
| `currency` | ISO code (default: the customer's currency) |

<a id="get-reports-supplier-statement"></a>

#### GET `/reports/supplier-statement`

Statement of account for one supplier in one currency.

- **Permission:** `permission-accounting-report-get`
- **Returns (`data`):** `PartyStatement`

| Query parameter | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `supplier_id` | Supplier id (required) |
| `from_date` | YYYY-MM-DD (default: start of the year) |
| `to_date` | YYYY-MM-DD (default: today) |
| `currency` | ISO code (default: the supplier's currency) |
